value.rationale: Triangle closure and unclosed wedges are fundamental coupled motif counts. A uniform fixed-edge null model and an independent-edge null model have qualitatively different covariance signs; the result identifies every finite density where the conditional negative dependence is strict and quantifies the dense limit. This is a natural structural dependence distinction rather than an arbitrary parameter slice, known single-motif mean, or normalization artifact.
